title: Monthly statements
subtitle: Sign-in/sign-out statements employees review, comment on and digitally sign.

status.finalApproved: Final — approved by your reporting manager
status.pendingApproval: Signed — waiting for your reporting manager's approval

list.emptyHint: Issue a month to email every employee their statement for review and signature.
list.inboxEmptyHint: Statements whose comments need your approval will appear here.

issue.title: Issue monthly statements
issue.description: Every employee with attendance records in the month receives an email with a personal review link.
issue.queued: Statements for {{month}} are being generated and emailed.
issue.hint: Employees who already have a statement for this month are skipped, so re-issuing fills gaps only.

detail.title: Statement — {{period}}
detail.approveDescription: The employee raised {{count}} comment(s) on their sign-in/sign-out times. Approving finalises the statement as the month's record.
detail.approveNotePlaceholder: e.g. Punch correction submitted for 12 Aug.
detail.resendQueued: A fresh review link is being emailed. The old link stops working.
detail.voidDescription: Voiding withdraws the review link. Use this before re-issuing a corrected month. The signed record of a finalised statement can never be voided.
detail.voidReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Attendance recomputed after device resync.

review.title: Attendance statement — {{period}}
review.invalidBody: The statement link is missing or incorrect. Please open the exact link from your email, or ask HR to send it again.
review.expiredBody: For your privacy, statement links stop working after a while. Ask HR to resend your statement.
review.introBody: Check each day's sign-in and sign-out. If a time is wrong, add a comment on that day — comments go to your reporting manager for approval. When everything is checked, sign at the bottom.
review.commentPlaceholder: What is wrong with this day's sign-in or sign-out?

sign.title: Digital signature
sign.noComments: You raised no comments. Signing confirms this statement as your final record for the month.
sign.withComments: You raised {{count}} comment(s). After you sign, the statement goes to your reporting manager for approval.
sign.nameLabel: Type your full name to sign
sign.confirmText: I have reviewed my sign-in and sign-out times for this month and confirm this statement, together with any comments I added, is accurate to the best of my knowledge.
sign.failedBody: Something went wrong while submitting. Please try again.
